# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `mindmux` MCP server pointing at MindMux's hosted endpoint (`https://mcp.mindmux.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth sign-in to mindmux.ai.
- Logo: references MindMux's hosted icon (`https://mindmux.ai/icon.svg`); the file could not be downloaded when this plugin was added.
